svg.title: Растяжка грудных мышц у стены — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow white contour, vector traced. Draw a held one-arm pectoral stretch against a solid wall. A fully clothed athletic adult stands next to the solid wall. The wall is a single flat continuous solid vertical plane clearly shown by a wall-floor seam and a few wall texture lines, no opening or door frame. The arm nearest the wall extends to the side and slightly behind the torso, almost straight at shoulder height, with its open palm against the flat face of the wall. The chest and pelvis turn gently away from the supported hand. The other arm hangs relaxed and never touches the wall. The figure has two grounded feet in a slight split stance. Show the entire man and contact of palm and wall in a three-quarter view. No duplicate frame, no equipment, no text. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
